scripts.build:
if [ -z "$OPENNEXT_IN_PROGRESS" ]; then export OPENNEXT_IN_PROGRESS=true && npx @opennextjs/cloudflare build && node -e "const f='.open-next/cloudflare/next-env.mjs';if(require('fs').existsSync(f)){const s=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8');const lines=[...new Set(s.trim().split('
'))];require('fs').writeFileSync(f,lines.join('
')+'
')}" && cp .open-next/worker.js .open-next/assets/_worker.js; else next build --webpack; fi
scripts.deploy:
npx @opennextjs/cloudflare build && node -e "const f='.open-next/cloudflare/next-env.mjs';const s=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8');const lines=[...new Set(s.trim().split('
'))];require('fs').writeFileSync(f,lines.join('
')+'
')" && npx wrangler deploy -c wrangler-worker.toml
